company_description:
Aurelis Cloud is a Helsinki-headquartered AI infrastructure company serving customers across Europe, from start-ups to large enterprises. It provides GPU clusters, managed model inference, storage and networking for AI workloads, and operates its own data centre in Finland as it plans to expand capacity in Europe.

The company describes itself as engineering-first, focused on designing and reliably running large-scale platforms. Its culture combines a start-up atmosphere with ambitious engineering: employees are encouraged to contribute ideas, participate openly, keep learning and make a tangible impact. Small engineering teams own services in production, supported by blameless incident reviews and shared on-call responsibilities between developers and SREs.

Aurelis offers flexible, remote-friendly work based on trust and autonomy, with support for home offices, different time zones and personal commitments. It also highlights fair and transparent people practices, wellbeing benefits, clear development paths and regular team gatherings. The company has around 1,200 employees, most of them engineers, working across several European hubs.
